_comment: Empirical distinct (uid, action, artifact_type) triples observed on the production reference node over the 30 days ending 2026-09-02, exported read-only from the daemon journal (gate log, for execute) and the trust chain (for chain_append). Deliberately carries NO hostnames, NO IP addresses and NO artifact bodies. uid is attributed from the session-prefix -> owning client mapping; daemon-minted types (gate_intent/gate_execution/gate_rejection/outcome/node_config/proposal) are excluded because the daemon writes them internally rather than through a socket chain_append. This is the real traffic v0.2.0's blanket fed-narrowing refuses; the v0.2.1 socket_uid_chain_append_types policy must admit every chain_append row here.
source: production reference node, 30d ending 2026-09-02, read-only export
attribution_caveat: 196 'observation' entries also sit in the federation bridge's session prefix. They are NOT attributed to uid 993 here: 993's chain_append has been narrowed to the fed_* triple since 2026-08-11 and its bridge has worked throughout, so those rows are almost certainly pre-narrowing history written by another principal. Their timestamps could not be re-queried (the export session's keys were removed immediately after). Recorded so the exclusion is visible rather than silent.
